The Pound for Pound Podcast Episode 2: Avilie Zuyie, Indian Youth National Champion from Nagaland
videos.summary:
Welcome to Episode 2 of The Pound for Pound Podcast. This week our special guest is Avilie Zuyie, Indian Youth National Champion, Overall Champion of Nagaland and Pound for Pound Rank #1 armwrestler.

We talk about how Avilie got into armwrestling, what training looks like in Nagaland, and what it takes to go from a local table to national champion. We also cover the mindset, the technique and the plans for what comes next.

If you love armwrestling, whether you're just starting out or already competing, this one is for you.

videos.title: The Pound for Pound Podcast | Episode 1 | Chetna Sharma
videos.summary:
Welcome to Episode 1 of The Pound for Pound Podcast, with our first guest, Chetna Sharma.

Chetna is India's number one armwrestler, an 8-time national champion, and has been undefeated in India for 13 years. She is also Managing Director of Pound for Pound. 

In this episode we sit down to talk about her journey in armwrestling, what it takes to stay on top for over a decade, how she trains, and how armwrestling is growing in India.
